(5) BUDGET: 3 bilaterals applied ONCE at output (cheap vs K=30 unroll); iter-15 finished 16ep in 1020s -> ~14-16ep; train_n=200, max_train_s=1080, --time=00:30:00, 200-val -> 20-min.
